title: Staging Auto Pilot Git transport resilience with exact-SHA fail-closed guards

phases.objective: Make transient GitHub smart-HTTP resets recoverable through a bounded transport-aware retry while preserving exact-SHA, clean-worktree, origin-identity, and fail-closed deployment guards across every local Staging entrypoint.

e2e_journeys.actor: Local Windows Staging Auto Pilot and governed CI
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A Staging bootstrap, one-click launcher, Auto Pilot, or scheduled Auto-Deploy watcher reads GitHub state before local execution.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Transient Git transport failures retry with bounded backoff and explicit HTTP/1.1 plus protocol-0 options; non-retryable failures, exhausted retries, SHA mismatch, dirty worktrees, and invalid provenance remain fail-closed before Docker or database mutation.
steps: Validate the canonical GitHub origin identity and preserve the exact target ref contract.
Run Git reads and fetches through one shared transport helper with bounded retry and sanitized diagnostics.
Verify the fetched ref resolves to the exact expected commit before checkout or eligibility use.
Reload the exact checked-out launcher and preserve manifest hash and build-context provenance checks.
Continue to canonical Compose, app health, certification, and readback only after Git convergence.
Keep Production deployment, Hostinger mutation, Cloudflare DNS mutation, database migration, provider mutation, and force-push disabled.
assertions: Retry is limited to known transient transport failures and cannot convert SHA, auth, dirty-tree, or policy errors into success.
Each retry uses protocol.version=0 and http.version=HTTP/1.1 explicitly inside the Git invocation; no persistent user Git configuration is changed.
Retry attempts and transport mode are recorded without secrets, while remote URLs and credentials are sanitized from diagnostics.
An exhausted or non-retryable Git failure stops before checkout, Docker build, Compose up, schema import, tunnel start, or certification.
The fetched ref and checked-out HEAD remain exact 40-character SHA values and must equal the expected candidate.
All four local Staging callers use the shared helper: Start-AutoPilot, One-Click, Bootstrap, and Auto-Deploy.
The portable manifest includes and hashes the shared helper through the governed manifest writer.
No Production branch, Production runtime, provider, DNS, migration, grant, or database mutation is introduced.
